extras: Do not use with Pretty Properties enabled simultaneously to avoid duplicate code execution.
intentEvidence: I decided to split it off into a separate plugin for the people who don't need all the other Pretty Properties features.
motivation: The author split it off from Pretty Properties for users who only need task counting functionality.
problem: Users need an automated way to track and display the total number of tasks within a note directly in its properties.

relations.evidence: This plugin used to be a part of my another plugin, Pretty Properties
If TaskNotes support is enabled, it can also count the tasks created by TaskNotes plugin

summary: A plugin that counts tasks within a note and saves the resulting count to the note's properties.
